title: Book Three · Chapter 187: The Third Wood Sample
story:
In February, Ronan completes his seventh working week.

Since the third week, Ronan has received four more payments. Each Friday brings thirty yuan after five completed days. The four payments add one hundred and twenty. His work money becomes two hundred and seventy-nine.

At the February review, Dad adds twelve and Mum eight again. The parents hold two hundred and forty. All three saved amounts now total five hundred and thirty-nine and a half.

One afternoon, a man and his grown daughter come to choose a table for his wife's room.

He wants dark wood. The daughter wants a lighter colour. They look at two samples and keep moving them between the window and the counter.

Ronan listens for a while.

“Where will she use it?” he asks.

“By her chair,” the man says.

“For reading,” his daughter adds.

“Has she seen these colours?”

Both look at the samples.

“Not yet,” the daughter says.

The man puts the dark sample near the edge.

“This is like our old table.”

His daughter moves the light one beside it.

“The room is small. This may look better.”

They look at Ronan. He glances toward the window. In the sunlight, he likes the lighter colour too. He almost says so.

Then the daughter picks up the dark piece again.

“My mother may want the old colour.”

The man nods, but he does not put the light piece away.

Ronan brings both pieces back to the middle. He leaves a little space between them.

“Does she use the room in the morning?”

“In the evening mostly,” the daughter says.

The sunlight at the shop window will not show them that evening light. Ronan looks toward Mr Sun, who is finishing a note at the paper table.

“Let me ask about the samples.”

He waits beside the table until Mr Sun finishes the line.

Mr Sun comes to the front. He agrees to lend them three small samples until the next day. Ronan writes the return time on their sheet. He puts three marks beside it, one for each sample. The counter helper checks their number before they leave.

The man looks at the third piece.

“We haven't even discussed that one.”

“Now you can,” his daughter says.

They take the samples home. The next afternoon, the three pieces come back with the wife herself.

She puts the third sample beside the chair drawing.

“This one.”

Her husband looks at his daughter. Then all three laugh.

Ronan brings the checked size sheet to Mr Sun. The woman explains the height she needs beside her chair. Mr Sun talks through the final details with her.

After they leave, Ronan places the two rejected samples back in the box. The counter helper lifts the third one.

“The quietest sample won.”

“It waited for the right person,” Ronan says.

She smiles and puts it with the order papers.

That evening, Ronan tells Mum the story. She looks at the side of her own new jacket.

“I would want to choose the colour too.”

“I thought of you.”

She laughs and takes a piece of cloth from her basket. Ronan holds it near the window while she looks at the shade.

Dad comes in from work and studies them both.

“Am I choosing?”

“You can look,” Mum says.

Ronan laughs and keeps the cloth still while she turns it toward the last light.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sample＝样品；grown＝成年的；reject＝不选用、排除；shade＝颜色深浅。

## 理解问题

1. 四周工资和二月家存实际到账后，三份钱合计多少？
2. 谁才是桌子的主要使用者？三块样品怎样实际归还并帮助完成选择？

## 读句子

**The next afternoon, the three pieces come back with the wife herself.**

拆开看：The next afternoon, / the three pieces / come back / with the wife herself.

第二天下午／三块样品／被带了回来／这次女主人自己也来了。
